items.claim: The GPU dither loses its dot grid far from the grid origin, because the origin reaches the shader as an unreduced float32
items.note: `dither` now moves the origin by whole 4-dot Bayer cells in float64, so it lands within one cell of the buffer. The dots it moved go to the shader as a new `u_dotOffset` uniform (GLSL and WGSL), which is added back only for the protect-mask lookup. That offset is clamped to ±2^23, beyond which no protect mask can reach the buffer. The test copies the shader's float32 arithmetic with `Math.fround` and failed before the fix.

items.claim: `ditherPixels` returns `undefined` for an unknown method, and `dither` calls an unknown method error diffusion
items.note: Both now throw a `RangeError` naming the methods they take, and `dither` keeps its CPU-only message for `'floyd-steinberg'` and `'atkinson'` only.
